## Input studies

Read input studies and diseases (GSE ID is required in the `accession` column).

```{r input}
# Read config file
input_studies <- read_csv(
  "config/studies_AD.csv",
  col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Validate columns
if (!"accession" %in% colnames(input_studies)) {
  message("Columns are: ", paste(colnames(input_studies), collapse = ", "))
  stop("Input config file needs an accession column.", call. = FALSE)
}

# Validate only GSE
if (!all(grepl("^GSE[0-9]+$", input_studies$accession))) {
  stop("All accession values must be valid GSE accessions.", call. = FALSE)
}

glimpse(input_studies)
```

## Inspect input GSE studies

```{r inspect}
# Inspect one GSE without downloading count matrices
inspect_gse <- function(gse_id) {
  stopifnot(grepl("^GSE[0-9]+$", gse_id))
  
  # Retrieve series and sample metadata
  geo <- getGEO(
    gse_id,
    GSEMatrix = TRUE,
    getGPL = FALSE,
    destdir = tempdir() #avoid creating the GSE dir.
  )
  
  metadata <- map_dfr(
    geo,
    ~ Biobase::pData(.x) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")
  )
  
  # Extract sample information
  geo_samples <- Biobase::pData(geo[[1]]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("GSM") %>%
    dplyr::select(GSM, title) #eg. Alzheimer's|non-Alzheimer's Disease_Biological..
  
  head(geo_samples)
  
  # List supplementary files (without downloading)
  supp <- tryCatch(
    getGEOSuppFiles(
      gse_id,
      fetch_files = FALSE,
      baseDir = tempdir() #avoid creating the GSE dir.
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # Identify candidate count files
  count_files <- if(!is.null(supp)) {
    supp[
      grepl(
        "raw_counts|counts|count_matrix",
        rownames(supp),
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  list(
    accession = gse_id,
    metadata = metadata,
    n_samples = nrow(metadata),
    geo_samples = geo_samples,
    supplementary = supp,
    count_files = count_files
  )
}

# Inspect list of input studies
gse_info <- map(
  input_studies$accession,
  inspect_gse
)

# Name inspection results by GEO accession
names(gse_info) <- input_studies$accession

# Add GEO sample metadata to input studies
input_studies <- input_studies %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    geo_samples = map(
      accession,
      ~ gse_info[[.x]]$geo_samples
    )
  )
```

## Download NCBI-computed gene counts

```{r rawcounts}
# Function to download files from the NCBI-generated data
download_gse_counts <- function(
    gse_id,
    counts_dir = "data_ncbi/counts",
    annotation_dir = "data_ncbi/annotation",
    overwrite = FALSE
  ) {
  
  gse_id <- toupper(trimws(gse_id))
  
  stopifnot(grepl("^GSE[0-9]+$", gse_id))
  
  dir.create(counts_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(annotation_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # NCBI-generated filenames
  counts_file <- paste0(gse_id, "_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv.gz")
  annotation_file <- "Human.GRCh38.p13.annot.tsv.gz"
  
  # NCBI download endpoint
  make_url <- function(filename, accession = NULL) {
    base_url <- "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/download/"
    
    params <- c(
      "format=file",
      "type=rnaseq_counts",
      if (!is.null(accession)) {
        paste0("acc=", accession)
      },
      paste0("file=", filename)
    )
    
    paste0(base_url, "?", paste(params, collapse = "&"))
  }
  
  # Series raw counts
  counts_url <- make_url(counts_file, accession = gse_id)
  
  # Shared human annotation
  annotation_url <- make_url(annotation_file)
  
  # Print
  cat("Counts:", counts_url, "\n")
  cat("Annotation:", annotation_url, "\n")
  
  # Create file paths
  counts_path <- file.path(counts_dir, counts_file)
  annotation_path <- file.path(annotation_dir, annotation_file)
  
  # Check gzip signature and first readable line
  valid_gzip <- function(path) {
    if (!file.exists(path) ||
        file.info(path)$size < 100) {
      return(FALSE)
    }
    
    con <- file(path, open = "rb")
    magic <- readBin(con, "raw", n = 2)
    close(con)
    
    if (!identical(magic, as.raw(c(0x1f, 0x8b)))) {
      return(FALSE)
    }
    
    tryCatch({
      con <- gzfile(path, "rt")
      on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
      length(readLines(con, n = 1, warn = FALSE)) == 1
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  }
  
  # Reusable downloader
  fetch_file <- function(url, dest) {
    if (!overwrite && valid_gzip(dest)) {
      message("Already downloaded: ", basename(dest))
      return(dest)
    }
    
    tmp <- paste0(dest, ".part")
    if (file.exists(tmp)) unlink(tmp)
    
    message("Downloading: ", basename(dest))
    
    tryCatch({
      download.file(
        url = url,
        destfile = tmp,
        method = "libcurl",
        mode = "wb",
        quiet = TRUE,
        timeout = 600
      )
      
      if (!valid_gzip(tmp)) {
        stop("Invalid gzip file or unavailable resource")
      }
      
      if (file.exists(dest)) unlink(dest)
      
      if (!file.rename(tmp, dest)) {
        stop("Could not move downloaded file")
      }
      
      dest
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (file.exists(tmp)) unlink(tmp)
      
      warning(
        "Failed: ", basename(dest),
        " — ", conditionMessage(e)
      )
      
      NA_character_
    })
  }
  
  # Download raw counts and shared annotation
  counts_result <- fetch_file(counts_url, counts_path)
  #annotation_result <- fetch_file(annotation_url, annotation_path)
  
  tibble(
    accession = gse_id,
    counts_path = counts_result,
    #annotation_path = annotation_result,
    counts_downloaded = !is.na(counts_result),
    #annotation_downloaded = !is.na(annotation_result)
  )
}

# Batch screening of multiple studies
download_result <- map(
  input_studies$accession,
  download_gse_counts
) #download_gse_counts("GSE113524")
```

## Download study metadata

```{r metadata}
# Function to resolve SRP using Entrez
resolve_srp_entrez <- function(gse_id) {
  # Search GEO DataSets for the exact GSE
  gds <- entrez_search(
    db = "gds",
    term = paste0(gse_id, "[ACCN] AND gse[ETYP]")
  )
  
  if (length(gds$ids) == 0L) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Find linked SRA experiment records
  links <- entrez_link(
    dbfrom = "gds",
    db = "sra",
    id = gds$ids,
    cmd = "neighbor"
  )
  
  sra_ids <- links$links$gds_sra
  
  if (is.null(sra_ids) || length(sra_ids) == 0L) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Retrieve RunInfo metadata
  csv_text <- entrez_fetch(
    db = "sra",
    id = sra_ids,
    rettype = "runinfo",
    retmode = "text"
  )
  
  runinfo <- read_csv(
    I(csv_text),
    col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  if (!"SRAStudy" %in% names(runinfo)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Extract unique SRP accessions
  srp <- unique(runinfo$SRAStudy)
  
  srp <- srp[
    !is.na(srp) &
      grepl("^SRP[0-9]+$", srp)
  ]
  
  if (length(srp) == 1L) {
    return(srp)
  }
  
  if (length(srp) > 1L) {
    warning(
      "Multiple SRP accessions found for ",
      gse_id, ": ",
      paste(srp, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  NA_character_
}

# Function to convert GSE to SRP accessions
resolve_sra_accession <- function(accession, strict = FALSE) {
  accession <- toupper(trimws(accession))
  
  # Helper for unsuccessful resolution
  fail <- function(message) {
    if (strict) stop(message, call. = FALSE)
    warning(message, call. = FALSE)
    NA_character_
  }
  
  # Validate input
  if (length(accession) != 1L ||
      is.na(accession) ||
      !grepl("^(GSE|SRP)[0-9]+$", accession)) {
    return(fail("Invalid GSE/SRP accession format"))
  }
  
  # Already an SRA project
  if (grepl("^SRP[0-9]+$", accession)) {
    return(accession)
  }
  
  message("Resolving GSE to SRP: ", accession)
  
  # 1. Try Entrez first
  srp <- tryCatch(
    resolve_srp_entrez(accession), #GEO–SRA linkage
    error = function(e) {
      warning("Entrez lookup failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NA_character_
    }
  )
  
  if (length(srp) == 1L && !is.na(srp)) {
    message(accession, " -> ", srp)
    return(srp)
  }
  
  # 2. Fall back to GEOquery
  message("Entrez lookup unsuccessful. Trying GEOquery...")
  
  # Retrieve GEO series metadata
  geo <- tryCatch(
    getGEO(
      accession,
      GSEMatrix = FALSE,
      getGPL = FALSE,
      destdir = tempdir()
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("GEOquery lookup failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  if (is.null(geo)) {
    return(fail(
      paste("Could not retrieve GEO accession:", accession)
    ))
  }
  
  # Extract GEO series relations field
  relations <- GEOquery::Meta(geo)$relation
  
  if (is.null(relations)) {
    return(fail(
      paste("No SRA relation found for:", accession)
    ))
  }
  
  relations <- unlist(relations, use.names = FALSE)
  
  # Extract linked SRP accessions
  srp <- unique(unlist(
    regmatches(
      relations,
      gregexpr("SRP[0-9]+", relations)
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  ))
  
  # 3. Validate final result
  if (length(srp) == 0L) {
    return(fail(
      paste("No linked SRP found for:", accession)
    ))
  }
  
  if (length(srp) > 1L) {
    return(fail(
      paste(
        "Multiple SRP accessions found for:",
        accession,
        paste(srp, collapse = ", ")
      )
    ))
  }
  
  message(accession, " -> ", srp)
  
  return(srp)
}

# Access to the 'SraRunInfo.csv' file
download_sra_metadata <- function(
    accession,
    outdir = "data_ncbi/metadata",
    overwrite = FALSE
  ) {
  
  accession <- toupper(trimws(accession))
  stopifnot(grepl("^(GSE|SRP)[0-9]+$", accession))
  
  study_dir <- file.path(outdir, accession)
  dir.create(study_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  dest <- file.path(study_dir, "SraRunInfo.csv")
  
  if (file.exists(dest) && !overwrite) {
    message("Already downloaded: ", dest)
    return(dest)
  }
  
  # Search the SRA database
  search <- entrez_search(
    db = "sra",
    term = paste0(accession, "[All Fields]"),
    use_history = TRUE,
    retmax = 0
  )
  
  if (search$count == 0) {
    stop("No SRA records found: ", accession)
  }
  
  # Retrieve metadata using E-utilities
  csv_text <- entrez_fetch(
    db = "sra",
    web_history = search$web_history,
    rettype = "runinfo",
    retmode = "text"
  )
  
  metadata <- read_csv(
    I(csv_text),
    col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  if (!"Run" %in% names(metadata) ||
      nrow(metadata) == 0) {
    stop("Invalid RunInfo response: ", accession)
  }
  
  write_csv(metadata, dest)
  
  message(
    "Saved ", nrow(metadata),
    " sequencing runs: ", dest
  )
  
  dest
}

# Access to the 'SraRunTable.csv' file
download_sra_run_table <- function(
    accession,
    outdir = "data_ncbi/metadata",
    batch_size = 100L,
    overwrite = FALSE
  ) {
  
  accession <- toupper(trimws(accession))
  stopifnot(grepl("^(GSE|SRP)[0-9]+$", accession))
  
  study_dir <- file.path(outdir, accession)
  dir.create(study_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  dest <- file.path(study_dir, "SraRunTable.csv")
  
  if (file.exists(dest) && !overwrite) {
    message("Already downloaded: ", dest)
    return(dest)
  }
  
  # Search NCBI SRA
  search <- entrez_search(
    db = "sra",
    term = paste0(accession, "[All Fields]"),
    retmax = 0,
    use_history = TRUE
  )
  
  if (search$count == 0) {
    stop("No SRA records found for ", accession)
  }
  
  # Extract one record's attributes
  parse_package <- function(pkg) {
    experiment <- xml2::xml_text(
      xml2::xml_find_first(
        pkg, "./EXPERIMENT/@accession"
      )
    )
    
    # Experiment accession from XML attribute
    experiment <- xml2::xml_attr(
      xml2::xml_find_first(pkg, "./EXPERIMENT"),
      "accession"
    )
    
    # Retrieve runs for this experiment
    runs <- xml2::xml_attr(
      xml2::xml_find_all(pkg, "./RUN_SET/RUN"),
      "accession"
    )
    
    if (length(runs) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # Submitted sample attributes
    nodes <- xml2::xml_find_all(
      pkg, "./SAMPLE/SAMPLE_ATTRIBUTES/SAMPLE_ATTRIBUTE"
    )
    
    tags <- xml2::xml_text(
      xml2::xml_find_all(nodes, "./TAG")
    )
    
    values <- xml2::xml_text(
      xml2::xml_find_all(nodes, "./VALUE")
    )
    
    attrs <- tibble(
      name = tags,
      value = values
    ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(name), nzchar(name)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        name = trimws(name),
        value = trimws(value)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(name) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        value = paste(unique(value), collapse = "; "),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    # Convert tags into individual columns
    wide <- if (nrow(attrs) > 0) {
      pivot_wider(
        attrs,
        names_from = name,
        values_from = value,
        names_prefix = "attr_"
      )
    } else {
      tibble(.placeholder = NA_character_) %>%
        dplyr::select(-.placeholder)
    }
    
    tibble(
      Run = runs,
      Experiment = experiment
    ) %>%
      bind_cols(wide[rep(1, length(runs)), , drop = FALSE])
  }
  
  # Fetch XML in batches
  starts <- seq(
    0, search$count - 1,
    by = batch_size
  )
  
  results <- map_dfr(starts, function(start) {
    message(
      "Fetching records ",
      start + 1, "–",
      min(start + batch_size, search$count)
    )
    
    xml_text <- rentrez::entrez_fetch(
      db = "sra",
      web_history = search$web_history,
      rettype = "xml",
      retmode = "xml",
      retstart = start,
      retmax = batch_size
    )
    
    doc <- xml2::read_xml(xml_text)
    
    packages <- xml2::xml_find_all(
      doc, ".//EXPERIMENT_PACKAGE"
    )
    
    map_dfr(packages, parse_package)
  })
  
  if (nrow(results) == 0) {
    stop("No run metadata extracted")
  }
  
  # Add standard sequencing information
  runinfo_path <- download_sra_metadata(accession, outdir = outdir)
  
  runinfo <- read_csv(runinfo_path, col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
  
  # One row per SRR run
  results <- runinfo %>%
    left_join(
      results %>%
        dplyr::select(-Experiment),
      by = "Run"
    )
  
  write_csv(results, dest)
  
  message("Saved ", nrow(results), " runs: ", dest)
  
  dest
}
```

## Export edgeR object

Validate the retrieved data and create an exportable DGEList object compatible with edgeR for downstream analysis. If multiple GSE studies are available, combine their count matrices by columns and export them as a single file. In addition, generate a summary report (`dge_raw_summary.csv`) describing the processed accession studies and general dataset metrics, such as the number of samples and genes.

```{r export}
# Function to collapse duplicated metadata
collapse_sra_metadata <- function(metadata) {
  stopifnot("SampleName" %in% names(metadata))
  
  if (anyNA(metadata$SampleName) ||
      any(!nzchar(trimws(metadata$SampleName)))) {
    stop("Missing or empty SampleName values.")
  }
  
  # Check biological sample identity
  if ("BioSample" %in% names(metadata)) {
    conflicts <- metadata %>%
      dplyr::group_by(SampleName) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_biosamples = n_distinct(
          BioSample[!is.na(BioSample) & nzchar(BioSample)]
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(n_biosamples > 1)
    
    if (nrow(conflicts) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Different BioSample identifiers share a SampleName: ",
        paste(conflicts$SampleName, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Check conflicting submitted biological attributes
  attr_cols <- grep(
    "^attr_",
    names(metadata),
    value = TRUE
  )
  
  for (col in attr_cols) {
    conflicts <- metadata %>%
      dplyr::group_by(SampleName) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_values = n_distinct(
          .data[[col]][
            !is.na(.data[[col]]) &
              nzchar(trimws(.data[[col]]))
          ]
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(n_values > 1)
    
    if (nrow(conflicts) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Conflicting values in ", col,
        " for SampleName: ",
        paste(conflicts$SampleName, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Collapse repeated runs
  metadata <- metadata %>%
    dplyr::group_by(SampleName) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      across(
        everything(),
        ~ {
          values <- unique(
            .x[!is.na(.x) & nzchar(trimws(.x))]
          )
          
          if (length(values) == 0) {
            NA_character_
          } else {
            paste(values, collapse = "; ") #eg. SRR1001; SRR1002..
          }
        }
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  metadata
}

# Function to retrieve the count matrix and its corresponding metadata
read_study_data <- function(
    accession,
    disease,
    srp_id,
    metadata_path,
    geo_samples,
    counts_dir = "data_ncbi/counts"
  ) {
  
  # 1. Read NCBI raw counts
  counts_path <- file.path(
    counts_dir,
    paste0(
      accession,
      "_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv.gz"
    )
  )
  
  if (!file.exists(counts_path)) {
    stop("Count matrix not found: ", counts_path)
  }
  
  counts_df <- read_tsv(
    counts_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  # First column contains gene ids (`GeneID`)
  gene_ids <- as.character(counts_df[[1]])
  
  if (anyNA(gene_ids) || anyDuplicated(gene_ids)) {
    stop("Missing or duplicated gene ids: ", accession)
  }
  
  # Other columns must contain numeric raw counts
  count_data <- counts_df[-1]
  
  if (!all(vapply(count_data, is.numeric, logical(1)))) {
    stop("Non-numeric count columns: ", accession)
  }
  
  counts <- as.matrix(count_data)
  rownames(counts) <- gene_ids
  
  # Validate original counts
  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(counts),
    all(is.finite(counts)),
    all(counts >= 0),
    all(counts == round(counts)),
    !anyDuplicated(colnames(counts))
  )
  
  # 2. Read SRA metadata
  if (!file.exists(metadata_path)) {
    stop("Metadata not found: ", metadata_path)
  }
  
  metadata <- read_csv(
    metadata_path,
    col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  if (!"SampleName" %in% names(metadata)) {
    stop("SampleName column missing: ", accession)
  }
  
  # Check repeated `SampleName` values
  n_runs <- nrow(metadata)
  n_samples <- n_distinct(metadata$SampleName)
  
  if (n_runs > n_samples) {
    message(
      accession, ": ",
      n_runs, " sequencing runs across ",
      n_samples, " unique SampleName values."
    )
    
    # Collapse duplicated sample metadata
    metadata <- collapse_sra_metadata(metadata)
    
    message(
      "Metadata collapsed to ",
      nrow(metadata),
      " unique samples."
    )
  }
  
  # Validate resulting metadata
  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(metadata$SampleName),
    !anyDuplicated(metadata$SampleName)
  )
  
  # Optional: add GEO sample titles
  stopifnot(
    all(c("GSM", "title") %in% names(geo_samples)),
    !anyDuplicated(geo_samples$GSM)
  )
  
  # Match GEO metadata using `SampleName`
  idx_geo <- match(
    metadata$SampleName,
    geo_samples$GSM
  )
  
  # Preserve original GEO titles
  metadata$attr_geo_title <- geo_samples$title[idx_geo]
  
  # Report matching
  message(
    accession, ": ",
    sum(!is.na(idx_geo)),
    " / ",
    nrow(metadata),
    " samples matched to GEO titles."
  )
  
  # 3. Match raw counts with metadata:
  # require one metadata record per count column
  idx <- match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName)
  
  if (anyNA(idx)) {
    stop(
      "Samples without matching metadata in ",
      accession, ": ",
      paste(
        colnames(counts)[is.na(idx)],
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Reorder metadata to count matrix columns
  metadata <- metadata[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName))
  
  # Add study information
  metadata$Study <- accession
  metadata$SRAStudy <- srp_id
  
  # Input disease identifies the target cohort, not the diagnosis of every sample
  metadata$target_disease <- disease
  
  list(counts = counts, metadata = metadata)
}

# Retrieve gene ids per study
gene_lists <- map(
  study_data,
  ~ rownames(.x$counts)
)

# Identify common genes
gene_lists <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  gene_lists
)

message("Common genes across studies: ", length(gene_lists))

if (length(gene_lists) == 0L) {
  stop("No common gene ids across studies.")
}

# Align matrices using the same gene ids
counts_merged <- map(
  study_data,
  ~ .x$counts[
    gene_lists,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

# Merge the raw count matrices (by sample columns)
counts_merged <- do.call(
  cbind,
  counts_merged
)

# Validate
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(colnames(counts_merged)),
  !anyDuplicated(rownames(counts_merged)),
  all(is.finite(counts_merged)),
  all(counts_merged >= 0)
)

dim(counts_merged)

# Combine all study metadata
metadata_merged <- study_data %>%
  map("metadata") %>%
  bind_rows() #handles different attributes ('attr_')

# Reorder according to merged count columns
metadata_merged <- metadata_merged[
  match(
    colnames(counts_merged),
    metadata_merged$SampleName
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# All available SRA attributes
grep(
  "^attr_",
  names(metadata_merged),
  value = TRUE
)

# Diagnosis distribution, when available
if ("attr_diagnosis" %in% names(metadata_merged)) {
  print(
    table(
      metadata_merged$Study,
      metadata_merged$attr_diagnosis,
      useNA = "ifany"
    )
  )
}

# Verify correspondence
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(metadata_merged$SampleName),
  identical(
    colnames(counts_merged),
    metadata_merged$SampleName
  )
)

# Convert `SampleName` into row names
metadata_merged <- column_to_rownames(metadata_merged, "SampleName")

# Read human NCBI annotation
annotation_path <- paste0(
  #data_ncbi/annotation
  "data_ncbi/",
  "annotation/",
  "Human.GRCh38.p13.annot.tsv.gz"
)

annotation <- read_tsv(
  annotation_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Inspect available columns
names(annotation)

# Match annotation with merged Gene IDs
annotation_ids <- as.character(annotation[["GeneID"]])

if (anyDuplicated(annotation_ids)) {
  stop("Duplicated gene ids in annotation.")
}

idx <- match(rownames(counts_merged), annotation_ids)

# Report annotation coverage
message(
  "Annotated genes: ",
  sum(!is.na(idx)),
  " / ",
  nrow(counts_merged)
)

if (all(is.na(idx))) {
  stop("No gene ids matched the annotation.")
}

# Match annotation to gene order
annotation <- as.data.frame(annotation[idx, , drop = FALSE])
rownames(annotation) <- rownames(counts_merged)
annotation <- annotation %>%
  dplyr::mutate(GeneID = as.character(GeneID)) #cast num to chr

# Final validation
stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(counts_merged), rownames(metadata_merged)),
  identical(rownames(counts_merged), rownames(annotation))
)

# Create raw edgeR object
dge_raw <- DGEList(
  counts = counts_merged,
  samples = metadata_merged,
  genes = annotation
)

glimpse(dge_raw)

# Create dir for main outputs
outdir <- "out_edgeR"

dir.create(
  outdir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Save DGE object
saveRDS(
  dge_raw,
  file.path(outdir, "dge_raw.rds"),
  compress = "bzip2"
)

message(
  "Saved merged DGE object: ",
  nrow(dge_raw), " genes and ",
  ncol(dge_raw), " samples from ",
  length(unique(dge_raw$samples$Study)), #Study = GSE
  " studies."
)

# Summarize metrics per study
dge_summary <- dge_raw$samples %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleName") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Study,
    SRAStudy,
    target_disease
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_genes = nrow(dge_raw),
    total_counts = sum(lib.size),
    median_libsize = median(lib.size),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    accession = Study,
    srp_id = SRAStudy
  )
print(dge_summary)

# Save a summary of the merged DGE object
write_csv(
  dge_summary,
  file.path(outdir, "dge_raw_summary.csv")
)
```
